'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**Five [[Palestinians]] are killed in two [[Israel]]i attacks in [[Khan Yunis]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-fire-kills-four-gaza-casting-further-doubt-ceasefire-2025-11-20/ (Reuters)]
**[[IDF|Israeli forces]] and tanks move {{cvt|300|m|ft|abbr=off}} beyond the [[Yellow Line (Gaza)|Yellow Line]] in [[Gaza City]], violating the ceasefire. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/20/palestinians-squeezed-as-israel-moves-beyond-yellow-line-in-gaza-city (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Two [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police|police officers]] are killed and four more injured after a bomb explodes near their [[armoured personnel carrier]] in [[Dera Ismail Khan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2025/11/20/two-policemen-martyred-four-injured-in-ied-attack-on-apc-in-dera-ismail-khan/ (''Pakistan Today'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Frida Kahlo]]'s 1940 self-portrait ''[[The Dream (The Bed)|El sueño (La cama)]]'' sells for US$54.66 million at [[Sotheby's]] in [[New York City]], [[United States]], setting a auction record for the [[List of most expensive paintings|most expensive painting]] by a woman, surpassing the previous high set by [[Georgia O'Keeffe]]'s ''[[Jimson Weed (painting)|Jimson Weed]]''. [https://www.france24.com/en/culture/20251121-frida-kahlo-self-portrait-auction-record-female-artists (AFP via France 24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Communications in the United States|American telecommunications]] company [[Verizon]] announces it will [[layoff|lay off]] over 13,000 employees, nearly 20% of its management workforce, in a [[restructuring]]. [https://apnews.com/article/verizon-layoffs-economy-jobs-1aa299fc28b8e7211188f9b084d1048c (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Two trains collide near [[České Budějovice]], [[Czech Republic]], injuring at least 57 people, including five seriously. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/11/20/dozens-injured-after-two-trains-collide-in-czech-republic (Euronews)] [https://apnews.com/article/czech-train-crash-8cd94b43ce95bab8a0277e9854a18c22 (AP)]
*Sixteen people are killed and 24 are injured when a tourist bus plunges off a bridge into a river in [[Santuk district]], [[Kampong Thom province]], [[Cambodia]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20251120/272374be8c5d4480be9a9d0351e9e799/c.html (Xinhua)]
*The toll from the [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s in [[Vietnam]] since the last four days increases to 41 people killed and nine missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/20/at-least-41-dead-as-heavy-rain-flooding-and-landslides-hit-central-vietnam (Al Jazeera)]
*The toll from the [[landslide]]s in [[Cilacap Regency]], [[Indonesia]], seven days ago, increases to 18 people killed and 34 others missing. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-landslides-central-java-rescue-operation-c08377f2102bcd125e84628cea3b5e12 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2025 United Nations Climate Change Conference]], [[Brazil–Germany relations]]
**At [[COP30]], [[Brazil]]ian [[Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (Brazil)|environment minister]] [[Marina Silva]] announces that [[Germany]] has committed to donate {{Euro}}1 billion (US$1.15 billion) towards Brazil's [[Tropical Forest Forever Facility|rainforest blended-finance mechanism]] over the next decade. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-pledges-1-billion-to-brazils-rainforest-protection-fund/a-74814439 (DW)]
**The conference is temporarily suspended after a fire breaks out at the venue. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce9d9p5jrjgo (BBC News)]
*At least 170 [[mountain climber]]s are evacuated when [[Semeru|Mount Semeru]] on [[Java]], [[Indonesia]], suddenly erupts. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-mount-semeru-volcano-eruption-climbers-569bcb33f108fce7075b483b5fda53ef (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–Lithuania relations]], [[Belarus–European Union border crisis]]
**[[Lithuania]] reopens its [[Medininkai]] and [[Šalčininkai]] [[Belarus–Lithuania border|border checkpoints]] with [[Belarus]] after closing them over security concerns involving [[weather balloon]]s used for smuggling. [https://tvpworld.com/90121121/lithuania-restores-travel-at-two-major-belarus-border-checkpoints (TVP World)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests]]
**Clashes erupt across [[Nepal]] between supporters of ousted [[Prime Minister of Nepal|prime minister]] [[K. P. Sharma Oli]] and supporters of [[Provisional government|interim prime minister]] [[Sushila Karki]]. A [[curfew]] is imposed in various [[List of districts of Nepal|districts]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/gatherings-banned-in-nepal-as-fresh-gen-z-protests-erupt-9669255 (NDTV)]
*[[Human trafficking in the Philippines]]
**A [[Philippines|Philippine]] [[regional trial court]] sentences former ''[[de facto]]'' [[Bamban]] mayor [[Alice Guo]] to [[life imprisonment]] after finding her guilty of [[human trafficking]] for a [[Philippine offshore gaming operator|scam center]] in her town. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-11-20/philippine-court-convicts-ex-mayor-for-human-trafficking-on-role-in-scam-center (Bloomberg)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2l20jzp30o (BBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria]]
**A [[Nigeria]]n [[Judiciary of Nigeria|court]] sentences [[Biafra]]n [[separatist]] [[Nnamdi Kanu]] to life imprisonment on seven [[Terrorism in Nigeria|terrorism]] charges over his leadership of the [[Indigenous People of Biafra]] militant group. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-nnamdi-kanu-9708d396efd89ac07b90b77d02fd96ff (AP)]
*[[Bulgaria]]n [[Law enforcement in Bulgaria|law enforcement]] arrests 35 people linked to a [[Transnational crime|transnational network]] accused of [[Antiquities trade|trafficking cultural goods]], with authorities reporting large seizures of artifacts, antique firearms, vehicles, and safes during coordinated raids with [[Europol]] and [[Eurojust]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/bulgaria-arrests-35-large-scale-trafficking-cultural-goods-2025-11-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[Spain]]'s [[Supreme Court of Spain|Supreme Court]] sentences [[Attorney General of Spain|Attorney General]] [[Álvaro García Ortiz]] to two years of [[Recusal|disqualification]] and a fine for revealing secrets about a [[tax fraud]] case involving [[Community of Madrid|Madrid]] [[President of Madrid|president]] [[Isabel Díaz Ayuso]]'s partner. [https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20251120/supremo-condena-fiscal-general-revelacion-datos-inhabilitacion-dos-anos-multa/16824031.shtml (RTVE)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Tongan general election]]
**[[Tonga]]ns vote to elect 26 of the 30 members of the [[Legislative Assembly of Tonga|Legislative Assembly]]. Members of the [[Tongan nobles|country's nobility]] elect nine representatives, while the rest of the voting population elect 17 [[Member of parliament|MP]]s. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/579439/tonga-election-polls-open-for-voters-to-elect-new-legislative-assembly (RNZ)]
*[[Brazil]]ian [[President of Brazil|president]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] appoints [[Attorney General of the Union (Brazil)|Attorney General]] [[Jorge Messias]] to the [[Supreme Federal Court]] to fill the seat that retired justice [[Luís Roberto Barroso]] vacated, pending [[Federal Senate (Brazil)|Senate]] confirmation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/lula-taps-brazils-solicitor-general-supreme-court-seat-2025-11-20/ (Reuters)]
